data.title: Xiao Xian Zhiyao
data.synopsis:
He Wan, the leader of the Hidden Clan feared by all three realms, suddenly attacked the Heavenly Palace. The Supreme God Nan Ze came to fight. In order to protect Nan Ze, the jade-growing fairy Yu Zhiyao risked her life to save him. When she and He Wan were about to perish together, she was unexpectedly reborn. By mistake, Yu Zhiyao was reborn into He Wan's body. After the rebirth, He Wan's Hidden Power was greatly damaged. Ting Zhao, the Hidden Guard of the West Sea, came to help the leader He Wan recover her Hidden Power. Since then, Zhiyao was forced to embark on the road of a two-faced female leader, pretending to be majestic in front of others and being charming in front of the king...

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

titles.title: Bao Ke Meng Shengtai Yi Riji

data.title: Bao Ke Meng Shengtai Yi Riji
data.synopsis:
Our planet is vast and colorful, and the world of Pokémon is equally vivid and magnificent.

Will the flame on the little Chimchar ever go out? Will Castform shape and type change with the weather? Can the Tepig's snout breathe fire?

Trainers, you are invited to come and discover the ecology here!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
data.background: The nine-minute animated short was released on April 22, 2025, to celebrate the World Earth Day. It was made available on Weibo, Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and Kuaishou in mainland China. It was later localized and published on the Japanese Pokemon YouTube channel on July 11, 2025 as part of the Pokémon Summer Stories collection.

data.title: Jigu-ui Juin-eun Goyangi-da
data.synopsis:
Though Chichi the cat looks very cute, she has one goal: eradicate humanity and take over the world! She decides to recruit comrades to aid her in her quest, but it looks like world conquest won't be that easy?! Follow the adventures of Chichi the tyrant, Dunno the doggo who loves humans, and Kaiser Kang Taeshik, the hard-boiled wild hamster, as they face many hardships on their path to absolute dominion!

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

data.title: Da Xia Qing Shang Gong
data.synopsis:
Fifty years ago, the martial arts world was suddenly invaded by "chaos." Murong Qiong formed a demon sect to fight against it, but they could not win despite the hard battle. The messenger of God Yi Zhihua came and taught everyone the demonization skills to successfully defeat the chaos. But the messenger of God left, and the demonization skills were introduced into the martial arts world and got out of control. Murong Qiong was disappointed and retired. His subordinate Yu Huabing took the opportunity to take over, improved the demonization skills, and created the punk invigoration era, making the martial arts world prosperous, but the price was that the martial artists all became "superior martial arts monsters." Dongfang Sheng, a young man with a pure heart, found Murong Qiong who had retired to the Xiangxi Hotel, hoping to rely on him to restore the former glory of the martial arts world. Thus this ridiculous story begins...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
